about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Jamaican Oven Jerk Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs rubbed with a fiery allspice, thyme and scotch bonnet paste, then roasted until sticky and charred.
steps: Blitz the spring onion, allspice, thyme, chilli, garlic, soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, oil and nutmeg to a coarse paste.
Slash the thighs to the bone, rub the paste in well, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Lay the chicken skin side up on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, until the skin is dark and crisp and the juices run clear.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with rice and peas or fried plantain.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Jamaican Curried Chicken
recipes.summary: A turmeric-heavy Jamaican curry of chicken and potato in a mellow, golden sauce with a little scotch bonnet heat.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Rub the chicken with half the curry powder and the turmeric and leave for 30 minutes.
Fry the remaining curry powder in the oil for 1 minute, then add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook until soft.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the potato, thyme, chilli and stock, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the potato is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Scatter with spring onion and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Chicken Pelau
recipes.summary: Chicken browned in burnt sugar, then cooked with rice, pigeon peas and coconut milk in one pot.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Season the chicken with the garlic, thyme and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot, add the sugar and cook until dark amber and foaming, then add the chicken and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the rice, peas and tomato sauce.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has absorbed.
Rest for 10 minutes, fold through the spring onion and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within an hour.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Doubles
recipes.summary: Soft fried bara flatbreads filled with spiced curried chickpeas and a sharp tamarind and chilli sauce.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, turmeric, sugar and a pinch of salt with the warm water into a soft dough. Knead for 5 minutes and rest, covered, for 1 hour.
Fry the onion and garlic until soft, add the cumin and curry powder for 1 minute, then add the chickpeas and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some chickpeas, until thick and saucy.
Stir the tamarind, chilli and lime juice together for the sauce.
Shape the dough into 12 thin discs and deep fry for 30 seconds a side, until puffed and pale gold.
Fill two bara with chickpeas, top with sauce and serve warm.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Aloo Pie
recipes.summary: Fried turmeric dough pockets filled with spiced mashed potato, served with tamarind chutney.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, turmeric, sugar, salt and water to a soft dough, knead for 5 minutes and rest for 1 hour.
Boil the potato until tender, drain, mash with the cumin, curry powder, garlic and spring onion, and cool.
Divide the dough into 6, flatten each, fill with potato, fold over and seal the edges firmly.
Deep fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and puffed.
Serve hot with the tamarind paste thinned with a little water.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Cuban Pan con Lechon
recipes.summary: Garlic and citrus roast pork piled into crusty bread with caramelised onions.
steps: Blend the garlic, juices, cumin, oregano and 2 tsp salt, pour over the pork and marinate overnight.
Heat the oven to 160°C. Roast the pork covered for 3 hours, until it pulls apart and reaches 90°C in the centre.
Cook the onion in the oil for 25 minutes, until soft and golden.
Shred the pork, moisten with the pan juices and pile into split rolls with the onions.
Toast the filled rolls in a hot pan or press for 2 minutes until the bread is crisp.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Pollo Guisado
recipes.summary: Chicken and potatoes braised in a sofrito-style tomato sauce with olives and capers.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Season the chicken with the cumin, oregano and salt.
Brown it in the oil in a large pot, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, stock and potato.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potato is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Add the olives, capers and coriander and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Pernil
recipes.summary: Garlic and oregano pork shoulder roasted low and slow until the crackling shatters.
steps: Crush the garlic, oregano, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper to a paste.
Score the skin, cut deep slits in the meat and rub the paste in everywhere. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Heat the oven to 160°C. Roast for 4 hours, until the meat reaches 90°C in the centre and shreds easily.
Increase to 230°C for the last 20 minutes, until the skin is blistered and crisp.
Rest for 20 minutes, then shred or carve.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Cottage Pie with Cheddar Mash
recipes.summary: Rich beef and vegetable mince under a golden, cheesy mash.
steps: Boil the potato until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk, then stir in half the cheddar.
Brown the mince in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the onion, carrot and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the paste and flour, then add the stock, worcestershire and thyme and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the mince into a baking dish, top with mash and the rest of the cheddar.
Bake for 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Steak and Ale Pie
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked beef and ale filling under a golden puff pastry lid.
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and brown in batches in the oil until deeply coloured.
Add the onion, carrot and mushroom and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the paste, ale, stock, bay leaves and thyme.
Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours, until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened. Cool slightly.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the filling into a pie dish, lay the pastry over, trim and brush with egg.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the pastry is puffed and golden.
notes: Food safety: mince and beef must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink in the middle. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Irish Beef and Guinness Stew
recipes.summary: Beef braised with root vegetables in a malty stout gravy.
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and brown in batches in the oil in a heavy pot until deeply coloured.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the paste.
Pour in the stout and stock, add the thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the carrot, parsnip and potato and cook for 40 minutes more, until the beef and vegetables are tender and the gravy has thickened.
Serve in wide bowls with soda bread to mop up the gravy.
notes: Food safety: mince and beef must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink in the middle. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Fish Pie with Prawns and Parsley
recipes.summary: Cod, salmon and prawns in a creamy parsley sauce under a golden mash crust.
steps: Poach the fish in the milk for 5 minutes, then strain, keeping the milk, and flake into a baking dish with the prawns and peas.
Make a sauce by melting 30g butter, stirring in the flour, then whisking in the hot milk until thick and smooth. Add the parsley and mustard and pour over the fish.
Boil the potato until tender, mash with the remaining butter and the egg, and spread over the top.
Bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 30 minutes, until golden and the filling is bubbling and prawns are pink.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, at least 63°C. Eat within a day of cooking and keep refrigerated.
Prawns must be pink and firm. Eat within a day of cooking.

recipes.title: Coronation Chicken Jacket Potato
recipes.summary: Curried chicken in a creamy mango mayo over a fluffy baked potato.
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200°C (180°C fan) for 1 hour, until the skins are crisp and the centres soft.
Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes, until cooked through at 75°C, then cool and shred.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, chutney, curry powder and lemon juice, then fold through the chicken, sultanas and spring onion.
Split the potatoes, fill with the chicken and top with almonds.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Keep the chicken mixture refrigerated until serving.

recipes.title: Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.summary: Thin veal cutlets crumbed and shallow-fried in butter until golden and puffed, with lemon.
steps: Crush the veal to 5mm thick and season well.
Dredge each piece in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing lightly.
Heat the butter and oil in a wide pan and fry the schnitzels for 2 to 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan, until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges, parsley and potato salad.
notes: Food safety: mince and beef must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink in the middle. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.
Veal must be cooked until no pink remains.

recipes.title: Hungarian Beef Goulash
recipes.summary: Beef and paprika slowly stewed with onions and capsicum until the sauce is rich and brick red.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches and set aside.
Cook the onion until deep gold, add the garlic, then take off the heat and stir in the paprika, caraway and paste.
Return the beef with the stock and bay leaves, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the capsicum and potato and cook for 40 minutes more, until the beef is tender and the sauce is thick.
Serve with bread or egg noodles.
notes: Food safety: mince and beef must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink in the middle. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Polish Bigos Hunter's Stew
recipes.summary: Sauerkraut, cabbage, pork and kielbasa simmered slowly into a smoky, tangy stew.
steps: Brown the pork and kielbasa in the oil in a large pot, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, cabbage, chopped soaked mushrooms, prunes, paste, bay leaves and juniper.
Pour in the stock and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the pork is very tender.
Rest overnight if you can, then reheat and serve with rye bread.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Sausage must reach 75°C in the centre.

recipes.title: Czech Bramboraky Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Crisp garlicky potato pancakes fried until lacy and golden.
steps: Grate the potato, squeeze out the liquid and mix with the eggs, flour, crushed garlic, marjoram and salt.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Drop in spoonfuls, flatten and fry for 3 to 4 minutes a side, until deep golden and crisp at the edges.
Drain on paper and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.
Dairy-free. Fry until the eggs are set through.

recipes.title: German Rouladen
recipes.summary: Beef slices rolled around bacon, mustard, onion and pickle, then braised in rich gravy.
steps: Spread each slice with mustard and top with bacon, onion and a pickle quarter, then roll up and tie with string.
Brown the rolls in the oil, set aside, then fry the carrot, celery and paste for 5 minutes.
Add the wine, stock and rolls, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, until the beef is very tender.
Whisk a little flour with water, stir into the pan juices and simmer until the gravy is thick.
Remove the string and serve with potato dumplings and red cabbage.
notes: Food safety: mince and beef must be cooked through to 75°C with no pink in the middle. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with saffron, ginger, olives and preserved lemon until the sauce turns fragrant and golden.
steps: Rub the chicken with the ginger, turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper and brown it in the oil in a heavy pot until golden on all sides.
Add the onion, garlic and saffron and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the stock, cover and simmer for 40 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has reduced.
Add the lemon rind and olives for the last 5 minutes.
Scatter with coriander and serve with couscous.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Egyptian Koshari
recipes.summary: Rice, lentils and pasta layered with spiced tomato sauce and crisp fried onions.
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender, drain, then cook the rice and pasta until tender.
Toss the onion in the flour and fry in the oil in batches for 15 minutes, until crisp and dark golden.
Fry the garlic and cumin in 2 tbsp oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and chilli and simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then add the vinegar.
Layer the rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas in bowls, spoon over the sauce and top with onions.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Egyptian Hawawshi
recipes.summary: Pita stuffed with spiced beef and onion, baked until the bread is crisp and the filling juicy.
steps: Mix the mince with the onion, capsicum, garlic, cumin, paprika, parsley, tomato and salt.
Cut the top off each pita to make a pocket and stuff with the filling, pressing it flat.
Brush with the oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 25 minutes, until the bread is crisp and the beef reaches 75°C.
Rest for 3 minutes, slice and serve.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Tunisian Chicken Couscous
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken and vegetables over fluffy couscous with a harissa broth.

items: 600g chicken thigh fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the harissa and cumin, then add the carrot, stock and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cook for 10 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Serve the stew over the couscous.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Algerian Chicken Chakchouka
recipes.summary: Peppers, tomatoes and chicken braised with cumin, finished with softly set eggs.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until no longer pink, then set aside.
Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic for 8 minutes, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Return the chicken, make 4 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are just soft.
Top with parsley and serve with bread.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set.
